name: personal-finance-server
description: Personal Finance & Expense Management System - backend API

scripts.migrate:test: export DATABASE_URL=$(node -p "require('dotenv').config(); process.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL") && node -r dotenv/config ./node_modules/node-pg-migrate/bin/node-pg-migrate up -m migrations
scripts.test:integration: npm run ensure:db && export DATABASE_URL=$(node -p "require('dotenv').config(); process.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL") && cross-env NODE_ENV=test node -r dotenv/config ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/tests/integration
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:integration
